item.title: Claude Opus 5 Underrated, Kimi K3 1.56TB Open-Weight, GLM 5.2 Becomes Security Default: July 2026 Model Landscape Shift
item.description: July's triple hit: Anthropic's Opus 5 tops coding but benchmarks underrate it, Moonshot's 2.8T-param Kimi K3 goes open-weight with a stricter license, and Zhipu's GLM 5.2 chosen by HuggingFace as their forensic tool — three forces reshaping the open/closed model landscape.

item.title: SOTA on Paper, Engineering Traps in Production: Claude Opus 5's Hidden Risks
item.description: Claude Opus 5 tops Frontier-Bench and CursorBench at half the price of Fable 5. We look past the benchmarks to three engineering traps most teams miss.
